verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS marketing platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents email creation, sending, analytics, CRM sync and an MCP server, but nothing about letting the account user opt out of HubSpot's own telemetry or usage tracking. Recipient-suppression settings such as unengaged-contact filtering cover email recipients, not the user's own telemetry, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
